title.en: An Act Granting to Jose A. Rigotti a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power Plant in the Municipalities of VIrac and Bato, Subprovince of Catanduanes, Province of Albay, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to Jose A. Rigotti, for a period of fifty years from the approval of this Act,
the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power system
for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for sale within the limits of the
municipalities of Virac and Bato, Subprovince of Catanduanes, Province of Albay, Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 26, 1930.
